meta.name: detect-zero-iteration-failures
meta.description: Identify and handle pre-execution agent failures occurring before any iterations or tool usage

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 捕获 agent 启动阶段的零轮失败
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 agent 在首次执行前就异常退出
copy.tagline_en: Catch pre-execution agent failures before first iteration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent fails before any tool use

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能识别出在开始执行任何步骤前就失败的agent任务，并提示这是系统级问题，需要检查基础设施而不是agent的指令或逻辑。
howto.when: 当你分析agent任务执行日志时，发现迭代次数为0、没有工具调用、没有产出文件、且对话只有用户指令时触发。

say.text: 检查这个任务日志，迭代次数是不是0？
say.note: Claude会验证零迭代失败模式。

say.text: 这个失败是系统级的，帮我排查环境配置。
say.note: Claude会建议转向基础设施排查。

say.text: 把失败归类为预执行失败并给出调查建议。
say.note: Claude会输出严重级别和应调查的团队。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can identify agent task executions that failed before any steps began, and indicate it's a system-level issue requiring infrastructure investigation rather than agent debugging.
howto.when_en: Triggers when analyzing agent execution logs showing 0 iterations, no tool usage, no artifacts created, and only a user instruction in the conversation.

say_en.text: Check this task log, is the iteration count zero?
This failure is system-level, help me investigate environment config.
Classify the failure as pre-execution and give investigation advice.
say_en.note: Claude outputs severity and team routing.
